name: Sense Allies
text:
**Sense Allies**

Wildborn who grow up together are closely attuned to the presence of others and carry this skill throughout their lives.

**Prerequisites**: Perception 3 ranks, wildborn half-elf.

**Benefit**: You are aware of the location of all allies within 60 feet, even if they are hiding, invisible, or otherwise could not normally be detected.
